key_points: Oracle launched Fusion Claw AI applications and new compliance tools, driving short-term optimism.
OpenAI growth and a NetApp partnership are viewed as positive catalysts for Oracle's cloud AI business.
Stock rose about 4% on Sep 29 following these announcements.
Analysts see substantial upside but remain cautious about AI spending intensity and margin pressures.
Rising bond yields, balance sheet leverage, and potential regulatory scrutiny on AI data-center deals pose risks.
